verdict.rationale: Gladia is an API service, so scoped or least-privilege credentials are a fair question to ask of it. However, the pack never documents issuing scoped, restricted, or per-agent API keys. The closest item is a live-session init URL and session id that clients can use without seeing the main credential. That is a related session-handoff mechanism, not a way to issue scoped API credentials, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
